## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the trigger and before/after result. Link the issue or proposal.

## Verification

List the commands actually run, results, macOS version and architecture. Separate offline evidence from any explicitly authorized live evidence. State unverified cases.

## Review checks

- [ ] I have the right to contribute this change under MIT and identified any third-party code or assets and their licenses.
- [ ] The change is focused; unrelated source and existing edits are preserved.
- [ ] Consequential behavior changes have a meaningful regression check.
- [ ] No credentials, real network/device identifiers or personal paths are included.
- [ ] I did not perform unapproved blocking, media playback or device changes.
- [ ] Claims distinguish policy, engine state, protocol coverage and observed outcomes.

For helper, discovery, capture or lifecycle changes, explain effects on Mac/router/trusted exclusions, stale callbacks, cancellation and cleanup. For a dependency, identify its license and runtime/install impact.
